description: A next hop of policy routing: the router at an address on one of the node's links, and a routing table of its own that holds a default route through it and an unreachable default route after it, so that the traffic is dropped while the link is down. PolicyRoute rules name it in `to.nextHop`; the rules that name one NextHop share its table, its route and its mark.

address.description: Address of the router the traffic leaves through: a unicast address, link-local ones included, and no IPv4-mapped IPv6 address. The rules that name the NextHop match packets of its family.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A NextHop's address is a unicast address: not unspecified, loopback, multicast, broadcast or IPv4-mapped IPv6.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the next hop " + self + " is no unicast address of a router, or is an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address; give the router's address, an IPv4 one as IPv4"

interface.description: Link the next hop is on, which a Network document names alone in its `[Match]` section; the route through the next hop goes into that Network.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A NextHop's interface is not lo.
x-chalkos-rules.message: the interface is lo, which no next hop is on; name the link the next hop is on

table.description: Routing table of the next hop, which no other NextHop uses: none of 253, 254 and 255, the kernel's own, no VRF's table and no PolicyRoute rule's `table`.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A NextHop's table is none of 253, 254 and 255, the kernel's own.
x-chalkos-rules.message: the table is 253, 254 or 255, the kernel's own; give the NextHop a table of its own

x-chalkos-rules.description: A NextHop's table is no VRF's table.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(v, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "VRF" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].VRF : {}), "the table is that of VRF " + v.filter(n, v[n].spec.table == self)[0] + "; give the NextHop a table of its own")
x-chalkos-rules.rule: cel.bind(v, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "VRF" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].VRF : {}), cel.bind(tables, v.map(n, v[n].spec.table), !(self in tables)))

x-chalkos-unique.hint: give each NextHop a table of its own

title: NextHop
